headline: Astera Labs and Amphenol: Quiet AI Capex Tax Collectors to Know Before Others Catch On
summary: Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) and Amphenol (NYSE: APH) delivered earnings reflecting the same thesis: sell the picks and shovels of AI rack-scale density. Astera reported Q2 revenue of $392.40 million, up 104.45% year over year. Amphenol posted $8.76 billion in sales, up 55%. Same tailwind, different vehicles. Scorpio Ignites Astera.
